title: Photographs
description: Look at each picture and listen to four statements. Choose the statement that best describes what you see in the picture.

questions.imageDescription: A woman working at a desk with a computer

options.text: The woman is sitting at her desk.
The woman is standing by the window.
The woman is talking on the phone outside.
The woman is reading a newspaper.

explanation.en: The image shows a woman sitting at a desk working on a computer. Option A correctly describes this action.
explanation.vi: Hình ảnh cho thấy một phụ nữ ngồi ở bàn làm việc trên máy tính. Tùy chọn A mô tả chính xác hành động này.

questions.imageDescription: People having a meeting around a conference table

options.text: The employees are having lunch in the cafeteria.
The employees are sitting around a conference table.
The employees are standing outside the building.
The employees are working at their desks.

explanation.en: The image shows employees gathered around a conference table in a meeting. Option B is the correct description.
explanation.vi: Hình ảnh cho thấy các nhân viên tập trung xung quanh bàn hội nghị trong một cuộc họp. Tùy chọn B là mô tả đúng.

questions.imageDescription: A delivery person unloading boxes from a truck

options.text: The delivery person is parking the truck.
The delivery person is unloading boxes from the truck.
The delivery person is loading boxes into a car.
The delivery person is standing on the road.

explanation.en: The image shows a delivery person unloading boxes from a truck. Option B correctly describes this activity.
explanation.vi: Hình ảnh cho thấy một người giao hàng dỡ những chiếc hộp từ xe tải. Tùy chọn B mô tả chính xác hoạt động này.

questions.imageDescription: Customers shopping in a retail store

options.text: The customers are shopping in the store.
The customers are closing the store.
The customers are waiting outside.
The customers are cleaning the shelves.

explanation.en: The image depicts customers browsing and shopping in a retail store environment. Option A is the correct answer.
explanation.vi: Hình ảnh mô tả các khách hàng duyệt và mua sắm ở cửa hàng bán lẻ. Tùy chọn A là câu trả lời đúng.

questions.imageDescription: Construction workers working on a building site

options.text: The workers are having a break under a tent.
The workers are working on the construction site.
The workers are entering the office building.
The workers are walking away from the site.

explanation.en: The image shows construction workers actively engaged on a building construction site. Option B correctly describes the scene.
explanation.vi: Hình ảnh cho thấy các công nhân xây dựng đang hoạt động tích cực tại công trường xây dựng. Tùy chọn B mô tả chính xác cảnh tượng.

options.text: The passengers are boarding the airplane.
The passengers are checking in at the airport counter.
The passengers are exiting the terminal.
The passengers are waiting for luggage.

explanation.en: The image shows passengers in the process of boarding an airplane. Option A is the correct answer.
explanation.vi: Hình ảnh cho thấy các hành khách đang lên máy bay. Tùy chọn A là câu trả lời đúng.
